notes.how_to_find_ip: On the laptop, run: ipconfig (Windows) or ifconfig (Mac/Linux) and look for the IPv4 address.
notes.static_ip: To prevent IP changes, set a static DHCP reservation in your router for the laptop's MAC address.
notes.firewall: Run the setup-firewall script to open port 3001.
notes.same_network: Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi network (or same VLAN).
notes.hostname_alternative: If mDNS works on your network, you can use 'algoflow.local' instead of the IP address.
